sentences.en: this code word level system solely for the purpose of protecting politically sensitive rather than national security sensitive information.
sentences.zh: 本质上是为了向泽连斯基明确表示，特朗普总统想要某种东西。

sentences.en: So the pattern being that the president has freewheeling, potentially inappropriate conversations
sentences.zh: 如果他得不到，两国关系就会恶化。

sentences.en: with foreign leaders and then locks them away, not for the normal reasons, but just because they may be embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 这项指控称，总统将联邦政府部门中他身边的许多人拉拢进来，试图为他完成这个所谓的“人情”。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the idea being that there are multiple officials around him, potentially including White
sentences.zh: 而且他通过许多不同的方式将其表达得如此明确，以至于在某些情况下，其中一些官员可能自行决定去做他们知道的

sentences.en: House lawyers, who have gotten into this habit of, OK, this is how you treat a conversation like this.
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: We just put it in the code word level system so that others inside the government who might be alarmed by this or might see something wrong with this don't ever see it.
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: Julie, is there anything else of note in this whistleblower's complaint?
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: The final allegation in the complaint is kind of a broad one about the ways in which the people
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: around President Trump sort of acted on their own to reinforce this essentially threat that he was
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: making or pressure campaign that he was trying to impose on the Ukrainian president.
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: So he talks about how he had learned that in mid-May, President Trump instructs Vice President Mike Pence to cancel a
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: Klan trip that he had to go to Ukraine to attend Zelensky's inauguration.
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: He also says that it was quote unquote made clear to people around President Trump that he didn't want to meet with President
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: Zelensky until he saw him choose to act in office, essentially until he started doing what it was that
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: Trump had asked him to do.
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: And so he writes, I do not know how this guidance was communicated or by whom, but he essentially is suggesting that this was all of a piece.
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: This was all sort of a coordinated campaign directed by the president and also just initiated by people around him who knew what he wanted to
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: have happen to essentially make it clear to Zelensky that there was something that President Trump wanted.
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: And if he didn't get it, the relationship would suffer.
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: The allegation being that the president enlisted lots of people around him in the federal branch of the government to try to get this favor done for him.
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: And that he had made it so clear in so many different ways that in some cases, some of these officials may have taken it upon themselves to do what it was that they knew the
sentences.zh: 总统想要完成的事。

sentences.en: president wanted.
sentences.zh: 总统通缉令。

sentences.en: So how did this complaint end up getting from the whistleblower's hands to all of us, to the public on Thursday morning?
sentences.zh: 那么，这份投诉是怎么从检举人手里最终传到我们所有人手中，并在周四上午公之于众的呢？

sentences.en: Well, that saga was the subject of this hearing on
sentences.zh: 嗯，这段波折正是这场听证会的主题

sentences.en: Thursday morning on Capitol Hill before the House Intelligence Committee, which had been trying for weeks to get a copy of this complaint and been stonewalled.
sentences.zh: 周四上午在国会山众议院情报委员会举行，该委员会数周来一直试图获取这份投诉的副本却频频受阻。

sentences.en: The complaint ended up coming out just as the hearing began.
sentences.zh: 这份投诉恰好在听证会开始时公之于众。

sentences.en: But many of the people in that hearing room were very focused on why it had taken so long to get the complaint in the first place.
sentences.zh: 但听证会现场的许多人非常关注为什么最初拿到这份投诉会花这么长时间。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用，即可免费访问30天。

sentences.en: So, Julie, tell us about this Intelligence Committee hearing in the
sentences.zh: 那么，朱莉，给我们讲讲众议院情报委员会的这场

sentences.en: House.
sentences.zh: 听证会吧。

sentences.en: So the hearing begins with the chairman of the committee, Adam Schiff, giving this really outraged speech.
sentences.zh: 听证会一开始，委员会主席亚当·希夫就发表了一番义愤填膺的演讲。

sentences.en: Yesterday, we were presented with the most graphic evidence yet that the president of the United States has betrayed his oath of office.
sentences.zh: 昨天，我们看到了迄今为止最具说服力的证据，表明美国总统背叛了他的就职誓言。

sentences.en: About what the allegations are.
sentences.zh: 关于这些指控的内容。

sentences.en: Yesterday, we were presented with a record of a call between the president of the United States and the president of
sentences.zh: 昨天，我们看到了一份美国总统与乌克兰总统通话的记录，

sentences.en: Ukraine in which the president, our president, sacrificed our national security and our constitution for his personal political benefit.
sentences.zh: 在通话中，总统——我们的总统，为了他个人的政治利益牺牲了我们的国家安全和宪法。

sentences.en: All the Democrats are chomping at the bit to have a chance to question Director McGuire about why they haven't gotten to see this complaint about what the underlying conduct was.
sentences.zh: 所有民主党人都摩拳擦掌，急切地想要有机会质问马圭尔局长，为什么他们一直看不到这份关于具体违规行为的投诉。

sentences.en: Do you solemnly swear or affirm that the testimony you will give today shall be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth?
sentences.zh: 你是否庄严宣誓或保证，你今天提供的证词将是真相、全部真相，且只包含真相？

sentences.en: So help you, God?
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你吗？

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You may be seated.
sentences.zh: 请坐。

sentences.en: Now, the first place you went was to the White House.
sentences.zh: 话说，你去的第一个地方是白宫。

sentences.en: Am I trying to understand that from your opening statement?
sentences.zh: 我是不是可以从你的开场陈述中这样理解？

sentences.en: It wasn't to the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 不是司法部。

sentences.en: The first place you went for a second opinion was to the White House?
sentences.zh: 你寻求第二意见的第一个地方是白宫？

sentences.en: They really are going after McGuire on the procedure by which he handled this whistleblower complaint.
sentences.zh: 他们确实在穷追猛打马圭尔处理这份检举投诉的程序。

sentences.en: Essentially asking him why he shared the complaint and went to the White House and the
sentences.zh: 本质上是在质问他，为什么在来到国会——也就是法律规定的那样——之前，

sentences.en: Department of Justice first before coming to Congress, which is what's laid out in the law.
sentences.zh: 他先将投诉分享给了白宫和司法部。

sentences.en: Let me ask you this.
sentences.zh: 请问你这个问题。

sentences.en: Do you think it's appropriate that you go to a department run by someone who's the subject of the complaint to get advice or who is a subject of the complaint or implicated in the
sentences.zh: 你认为去找一个由投诉对象本人管理、或者本人就是投诉对象、又或是卷入投诉中的部门，

sentences.en: complaint for advice as to whether you should provide that complaint to Congress?
sentences.zh: 来征求关于是否应该将投诉提交给国会的意见，这样做合适吗？

sentences.en: Did that conflict of interest concern you?
sentences.zh: 那个利益冲突没有让你感到担忧吗？

sentences.en: And essentially what they're saying is you had this complaint that had wrongdoing alleged on the part of the president and participation on the part of the attorney general.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是说，你遇到了这份投诉，其中指控总统存在不当行为，而司法部长也牵涉其中。

sentences.en: So then why would you go to the White House and the Department of Justice to ask permission to share that when they're essentially the subject of this complaint?
sentences.zh: 那么，既然白宫和司法部本质上就是这起投诉的当事人，你为什么还要去向他们请求批准分享投诉呢？

sentences.en: I'm just asking if the conflict of interest concerned you that...
sentences.zh: 我只是想问，那个利益冲突是否让你觉得……

sentences.en: Well, sir, I have to work with what I've got, and that is the Office of Legal Counsel within the executive branch.
sentences.zh: 嗯，先生，我只能利用我手头现有的资源，也就是行政部门内部的法律顾问办公室。

sentences.en: And how does McGuire respond to these very pointed questions of why did you first consult with essentially the accused about how to handle a whistleblower complaint about
sentences.zh: 马圭尔如何回应这些极其尖锐的问题：为什么你要先与被指控者商讨如何处理针对被指控者的检举投诉？

sentences.en: the accused?
sentences.zh: 有关投诉的处理？

sentences.en: McGuire is really trying to play it very carefully here.
sentences.zh: 马圭尔在这里真的是在非常小心翼翼地应对。

sentences.en: It was not stonewalling.
sentences.zh: 这不是故意拖延。

sentences.en: I didn't receive direction from anybody.
sentences.zh: 我没有接受任何人的指示。

sentences.en: I was just trying to work through the process and the law the way it is written.
sentences.zh: 我只是试图按照既定的流程和法律来推进事情。

sentences.en: I have to comply with the way the law is, not the way some people would like it to be.
sentences.zh: 我必须遵守法律原本的样子，而不是某些人希望它成为的样子。

sentences.en: And if I could do otherwise, it would have been much more convenient for me.
sentences.zh: 如果我能用别的方法，对我来说会方便得多。

sentences.en: It is pretty clear from the sequence of events that McGuire actually wanted to handle this whistleblower
sentences.zh: 从一系列事件来看，很明显马圭尔实际上是想以正确的方式处理这份检举

sentences.en: complaint in the right way, and yet the process ended up being very dissatisfying to members of
sentences.zh: 投诉，然而这一过程最终让国会议员们感到非常不满，

sentences.en: Congress, and they feel like they've been stiffed.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己被敷衍了。

sentences.en: So what he says is, repeatedly, he had to follow the law.
sentences.zh: 因此，他反复强调的是，他必须依法办事。

sentences.en: It did appear that it has executive privilege.
sentences.zh: 这确实显得享有行政特权。

sentences.en: There was a matter, he says, of executive privilege here because this involved the president.
sentences.zh: 他说，这里存在一个行政特权的问题，因为这涉及总统。

sentences.en: If it does have executive privilege, it is the White House that determines that.
sentences.zh: 如果它确实拥有行政特权，那将由白宫来决定。

sentences.en: And so even though there's a statute that says an intelligence whistleblower complaint has got to be brought to Capitol Hill, has got to be shared with the intelligence committee,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管有法规规定情报检举投诉必须提交给国会山，必须与情报委员会共享，

sentences.en: he's saying there was this issue that involved the president, and it necessitated that I operate under the rules governing executive privilege.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，存在这样一个涉及总统的问题，这使得我必须在管辖行政特权的规则下行事。

sentences.en: And until executive privilege is determined and cleared, I did not have the authority to be able to send that forward to the committee.
sentences.zh: 并且在行政特权得到确定和澄清之前，我无权将该文件发送给委员会。

sentences.en: Who's in charge of that?
sentences.zh: 谁负责这个？

sentences.en: The White House and the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 白宫和司法部。

sentences.en: I believe that this matter is unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 我认为这件事是史无前例的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He kept using the word unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 他不停地使用“史无前例”这个词。

sentences.en: It is unprecedented and is probably unprecedented as well.
sentences.zh: 这确实是史无前例的，而且可能也前所未有。

sentences.en: And I got the sense that he was a little bit exasperated and trying to explain, look, there are a set of rules around whistleblowers, but nobody wrote those rules
sentences.zh: 我有一种感觉，他有点恼火，并试图解释：听着，关于检举人有一套规则，但没有人写这些规则时

sentences.en: thinking that the whistle would be blown on the president.
sentences.zh: 会想到举报对象竟然会是总统。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That this was essentially a choice that he was not going to get to make on his own.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是一个他无法自己做出选择的选择。

sentences.en: I am not political.
sentences.zh: 我不是政治中人。

sentences.en: I am not partisan.
sentences.zh: 我不是党派中人。

sentences.en: And I did not look to be sitting here as the acting director of national intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我当初也并没有寻求坐在这里担任代理国家情报总监。

sentences.en: I thought that there were perhaps other people who would be best and more qualified to do that.
sentences.zh: 我认为可能还有其他人比我更合适、更有资格来做这件事。

sentences.en: He also seems authentically a bit wary of this whole process and a few times says, you know, I've been in this job for just a few weeks.
sentences.zh: 他也显得对整个过程确实有点戒备，好几次说道：你知道的，我上任才几个星期。

sentences.en: I am the acting DNI and I was still using Garmin to get to work.
sentences.zh: 我是代理国家情报总监，我上班时居然还在用佳明导航。

sentences.en: My life would have been a heck of a lot simpler without becoming the most famous man in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我要是没有成为全美国最著名的人，我的生活本可以简单得多。

sentences.en: Don't doubt that at all, sir.
sentences.zh: 对此我绝对不怀疑，先生。

sentences.en: My question, sir...
sentences.zh: 我的问题是，先生……

sentences.en: It was this sense of, give me a break.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉就像是，饶了我吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Also a sense of, I don't have anything to do with this.
sentences.zh: 同时也有一种感觉，这跟我没有任何关系。

sentences.en: I mean, it is pretty clear from his testimony that he thinks that the matters that are raised in this complaint are a huge deal and he does not want to be associated with them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从他的证词中可以非常清楚地看出，他认为这份投诉中提出的问题是一件大事，而且他不想与这些事情扯上关系。

sentences.en: And as the members of Congress try to get him to essentially admit some sort of complicity or that he knew something, he keeps reminding them.
sentences.zh: 当国会议员试图让他承认某种串通行为或者他知道些什么时，他不断提醒他们：

sentences.en: My first day on the job was Friday the 16th of AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 我上班的第一天是8月16日，星期五。

sentences.en: And I think I set a new record in the administration for being subpoenaed before any...
sentences.zh: 我想我在政府里创下了一个新纪录，那就是在任何……之前就被传唤了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: You had a heck of a first week, didn't you, sir?
sentences.zh: 你第一周过得真够呛，对吧，先生？

sentences.en: Not that much going for me, sir.
sentences.zh: 我可没那么多好事，先生。

sentences.en: I've been the DNI for six weeks.
sentences.zh: 我担任情报总监已经六周了。

sentences.en: As you know, the phone call happened on July 25th of this year.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，那通电话发生在今年7月25日。

sentences.en: At that time, the DNI was Dan Coats.
sentences.zh: 当时的情报总监是丹·科茨。

sentences.en: And at one point, he's even asked if he was told by his predecessor, Dan Coats, who was the director of national intelligence right before he came on board,
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，甚至有人问他，他的前任丹·科茨——也就是在他上任前不久担任国家情报总监的人——是否向他提及过

sentences.en: about this July 25th call or about the whistleblower complaint.
sentences.zh: 这通7月25日的电话或检举投诉。

sentences.en: Did you discuss the July 25th call or the whistleblower complaint with DNI Coats?
sentences.zh: 你是否曾与情报总监科茨讨论过7月25日的通话或检举投诉？

sentences.en: And he essentially says...
sentences.zh: 而他基本上回答说……

sentences.en: I wouldn't have taken the job if I did.
sentences.zh: 我要是知道的话就不会接受这份工作了。

sentences.en: No, sir.
sentences.zh: 没有，先生。

sentences.en: If I had known, I would not have taken this job.
sentences.zh: 如果我早知道的话，我绝不会接这份工作。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对的，对的。

sentences.en: This is sort of the acting director appointment of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是一生难求的代理局长任命。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he seems to appreciate the irony there.
sentences.zh: 他似乎也体会到了其中的讽刺意味。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 唔。

sentences.en: So what happens on the Republican side?
sentences.zh: 那么共和党那边情况如何？

sentences.en: The Republicans are pretty much unanimously indignant about this.
sentences.zh: 共和党人对此几乎异口同声地感到愤慨。

sentences.en: We've learned the following.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到了以下情况。

sentences.en: The complaint relied on hearsay evidence provided by the whistleblower.
sentences.zh: 该投诉依赖于检举人提供的传闻证据。

sentences.en: The inspector general did not know the contents of the phone call at issue.
sentences.zh: 督察长并不了解涉事电话的内容。

sentences.en: The inspector general found the whistleblower displayed arguable political bias against Trump.
sentences.zh: 督察长发现检举人对特朗普表现出明显的政治偏见。

sentences.en: And they are coming to the president's defense that this is a fishing expedition on the part of the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 他们站出来为总统辩护，认为这是民主党人的一场捕风捉影的钓鱼执法。

sentences.en: I want to congratulate the Democrats on the rollout of their latest information warfare operation against the president.
sentences.zh: 我要祝贺民主党人成功推出了他们针对总统的最新信息战行动。

sentences.en: And they essentially are saying, you know, the Democrats have been trying for months and months.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在说，你知道的，民主党人已经尝试了几个月又几个月。

sentences.en: This operation began with media reports from the prime instigators of the Russia collusion hoax.
sentences.zh: 这次行动始于俄罗斯勾结骗局的始作俑者的媒体报道。

sentences.en: And they couldn't make that case, so now they're kind of grasping for straws on this.
sentences.zh: 他们没能坐实那个案子，所以现在在这个问题上有点病急乱投医了。

sentences.en: So there you go.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: If the whistleblower operation doesn't work out, the Democrats and their media assets can always drum up something else.
sentences.zh: 如果检举行动行不通，民主党及其媒体资产随时可以凭空捏造出别的东西。

sentences.en: Thank you, Director.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，局长。

sentences.en: We are adjourned.
sentences.zh: 我们休会。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，主席先生。

sentences.en: Julie, what do you feel came out of this hearing?
sentences.zh: 朱莉，你觉得这场听证会取得了什么成果？

sentences.en: I think that what members of Congress got out of this is a real sense that the whistleblower complaint is a serious thing that the intelligence community took very seriously.
sentences.zh: 我认为国会议员从这次听证会中得出的一种切身感受是，检举投诉是一件严肃的事情，情报部门非常认真地对待了它。

sentences.en: They're still angry about the fact that it took them a few weeks and a lot of machinations to get a hold of it.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然对花了好几周时间和进行了大量运作才拿到这份投诉感到生气。

sentences.en: But they now have the complaint.
sentences.zh: 但他们现在已经拿到投诉了。

sentences.en: So it's almost as if this hearing kind of puts a pin in that.
sentences.zh: 所以这就好比这场听证会暂时把这件事告一段落。

sentences.en: And now they move on to, OK, we have this information.
sentences.zh: 现在他们可以进入下一步：好了，我们有了这些信息。

sentences.en: What are we actually going to do with it?
sentences.zh: 我们到底要拿它怎么办？

sentences.en: And what are they going to do with it?
sentences.zh: 那他们打算怎么处理？

sentences.en: Well, after the hearing, Adam Schiff, the chairman of the Intelligence Committee, said that...
sentences.zh: 听证会结束后，情报委员会主席亚当·希夫表示……

sentences.en: I think the complaint gives us a pretty good roadmap of allegations that we need to investigate.
sentences.zh: 我认为这份投诉为我们需要调查的指控提供了一份相当不错的路线图。

sentences.en: The complaint was going to be a roadmap for the impeachment inquiry, essentially.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，这份投诉将成为弹劾调查的路线图。

sentences.en: There is a whole host of people, apparently, who have knowledge of these events.
sentences.zh: 显然有一大群人了解这些事件。

sentences.en: We'll do our best to identify those.
sentences.zh: 我们会尽最大努力识别出这些人。

sentences.en: We're obviously going to be bringing the whistleblower in.
sentences.zh: 我们显然会把检举人找来。

sentences.en: This is now going to form the backbone of their investigation.
sentences.zh: 这现在将成为他们调查的骨干。

sentences.en: There had been discussions among Democrats about should they have a big, expansive inquiry that would wrap in the Mueller report and potential obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 民主党内部曾讨论过，他们是否应该开展一项规模宏大、范围广泛的调查，将穆勒报告和潜在的妨碍司法公正行为也囊括其中。

sentences.en: I think after today, those questions are pretty much put to rest in the eyes of Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我认为在今天之后，在民主党人眼中，这些问题基本可以平息了。

sentences.en: They see this Ukraine matter as the central element of an impeachment case against President Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们将这起乌克兰事件视为针对特朗普总统弹劾案的核心要素。

sentences.en: And that is the road they're going to go down.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们要走的路线。

sentences.en: So we are going to see them try to get access to the whistleblower.
sentences.zh: 所以我们将看到他们试图接触检举人。

sentences.en: We're going to see them try to question the officials that are referenced in this complaint, where he talks about people who are concerned,
sentences.zh: 我们将看到他们试图质询本投诉中提及的官员，他在其中谈到了那些感到担忧、

sentences.en: who came to him and shared these accounts that were troubling.
sentences.zh: 并向他分享这些令人不安的叙述的人。

sentences.en: And that's going to be the entry point for them to potentially draft articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 这将成为他们潜在起草弹劾条款的切入点。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the whistleblower, who remains anonymous, is a CIA officer who once worked at the White House.
sentences.zh: 据《时报》报道，至今保持匿名的检举人是一名曾在白宫工作过的中情局官员。

sentences.en: I want to know who's the person that gave the whistleblower the information, because that's supposed to a spy.
sentences.zh: 我想知道是谁把信息提供给检举人的，因为那本该是个间谍。

sentences.en: On Thursday, during a private meeting with aides at the United Nations, President Trump compared the whistleblower's sources to spies,
sentences.zh: 据《洛杉矶时报》获得的音频显示，周四在联合国与助手举行的一次闭门会议上，特朗普总统将检举人的消息来源比作间谍，

sentences.en: according to audio obtained by the Los Angeles Times, and went on to seemingly threaten both the whistleblower and his sources.
sentences.zh: 并且接着似乎对检举人及其消息来源都发出了威胁。

sentences.en: You know what we used to do in the old days, when we were smart, the spies and treasles, we used to handle it a little differently than we do now.
sentences.zh: 你知道以前当我们还很聪明的时候，我们这些间谍和叛徒是怎么做的吗？我们处理问题的方式可跟现在不太一样。

sentences.en: During a news conference on Capitol Hill, House Speaker Nancy Pelosi said that the impeachment process would be methodical, open-minded, and fair.
sentences.zh: 在国会山的一场新闻发布会上，众议院议长南希·佩洛西表示，弹劾程序将是有条不紊、思想开放且公正的。

sentences.en: There is no rush to judgment, and in some ways we are a jury, open to what might be exculpatory or not.
sentences.zh: 我们并不急于下结论，在某些方面我们就像一个陪审团，准备好听取可能洗脱罪名或与之相反的证据。

sentences.en: But every day, the sadness grows because the disregard for our Constitution that the president has becomes more clear.
sentences.zh: 但每一天，悲伤都在加剧，因为总统对我们宪法的蔑视变得越来越明显。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: On Thursday, the Trump administration proposed slashing the size of the American refugee program by almost half, saying it would accept 18,000 refugees over the next year,
sentences.zh: 周四，特朗普政府提议将美国难民接收计划的规模削减近一半，称其将在未来一年内接受1.8万名难民，

sentences.en: down from the current limit of 30,000.
sentences.zh: 低于目前的3万名上限。

sentences.en: The White House plans to reserve many of those slots for Iraqis who worked with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 白宫计划将其中许多名额留给曾与美军合作的伊拉克人，

sentences.en: military, as well as persecuted religious minorities, leaving few opportunities for refugees fleeing war and oppression throughout much of the world.
sentences.zh: 以及遭受迫害的宗教少数群体，这使得世界上许多地方逃离战争和压迫的难民几乎没有机会。

sentences.en: The move is part of a broader attempt by the president and his top advisor, Stephen Miller,
sentences.zh: 此举是总统及其高级顾问史蒂芬·米勒更广泛计划的一部分，

sentences.en: to reduce the number of both legal and undocumented immigrants entering the United States.
sentences.zh: 旨在减少进入美国的合法和无证移民数量。

sentences.zh: 他们是遮光睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝断片才能睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？
